svg.font-family: Arial, Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', FreeSans, Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: E-Paper Desk — build architecture
svg.desc: System map, website integration, 14 module build sheets, data contracts, data model, build order and 72-hour clock for a platform that turns any website's articles into editable newspaper pages, InDesign IDML, and a tappable e-paper.
svg.metadata: { "document": "E-Paper Desk: build architecture", "version": "1.1", "date": "2026-11-17", "new_in_this_version": "M13 ops desk + recovery · the 72-hour clock in section F · queue inside Postgres, no Redis · files on disk, no MinIO · contracts D9 health and D10 ops API · run 4", "how_to_use": [ "This JSON is the full content of the drawing. Build from it.", "Order: build_order.step_0 first (it includes the M13 safety net), then the three tracks in parallel, then join.", "clock_72h gives the hour budget and the exit check for every block. recovery holds the no-data-loss targets.", "decisions_closed are settled. Do not reopen them.", "A module is done only when every item in its done_when list passes.", "Contracts D1-D5 are frozen as zod schemas in packages/core before module work starts.", "Items in needs.from_client are inputs to request from the lead. Do not invent them.", "The default stack may be changed by the lead only if every contract and interface below is kept." ], "goal": "Any website's articles become editable newspaper pages, go to InDesign as IDML for final polish, and the final PDF becomes a tappable e-paper. Many papers, any language, new sites plug in by configuration.", "default_stack": { "language": "TypeScript monorepo (pnpm)", "api": "Fastify + zod, OpenAPI at /docs", "db": "Postgres + Prisma", "queue": "pg-boss, inside Postgres (no Redis)", "storage": "write-once files on local disk named by content hash; optional S3 driver (no MinIO)", "backups": "WAL-G (Postgres) + restic (files) to an S3 bucket off the box", "ops": "apps/ops: a standalone ops desk service", "render": "Playwright Chromium", "editor_admin": "React + Vite", "reader": "Preact static app + service worker", "pdf_tools": "Poppler CLI, qpdf, Tesseract, Ghostscript (phase 2)", "images": "sharp (libvips)", "ai": "Claude API, model id from env", "deploy": "Docker Compose + Caddy on one Linux box" }, "rules": [ { "n": 1, "title": "ONE ARTICLE SHAPE", "text": "Every source is mapped into the canonical Article (D1). Nothing downstream knows or cares where it came from." }, { "n": 2, "title": "ONE RENDERER", "text": "A page is HTML + CSS drawn by Chromium, in the editor and on the server. Same package, same pixels." }, { "n": 3, "title": "ONE SNAPSHOT", "text": "All geometry leaves as the Layout Snapshot (D4): frames in mm, made by the one renderer. No exporter reads the editor's live DOM." }, { "n": 4, "title": "TWO TRUTHS", "text": "Browser = content truth. InDesign PDF = print truth. E-paper is built from the final PDF whenever one exists." }, { "n": 5, "title": "AI SUGGESTS", "text": "The editor decides. Nothing is applied without a tap. No new facts. The language never changes." }, { "n": 6, "title": "PAPER_ID EVERYWHERE", "text": "Many papers from the first migration: every row, every file key, every job carries paper_id." }, { "n": 7, "title": "SAFE TO RE-RUN", "text": "Everything slow is a queue job with an idempotency key. Running it twice changes nothing." }, { "n": 8, "title": "FIXABLE BY THE OWNER", "text": "Every service has a light, a restart, its logs and a way back on the ops desk (M13). State lives in two places only, both copied off the box." } ], "lanes": [ { "no": "1", "name": "INGEST", "modules": [ "M1", "M2" ] }, { "no": "2", "name": "STORE", "modules": [ "M0" ] }, { "no": "3", "name": "BUILD PAGES", "modules": [ "M3", "M4", "M5" ] }, { "no": "4", "name": "EXPORT", "modules": [ "M6", "M7" ] }, { "no": "5", "name": "E-PAPER", "modules": [ "M8", "M9", "M10", "M11" ] }, { "no": "", "name": "ALL LANES", "modules": [ "M12", "M13" ] } ], "external_systems": [ "Any website / CMS (the client's)", "InDesign desk (client licence + operator)", "Printing press", "Claude API", "Readers", "Off-box backup bucket (any S3)", "The owner's phone (alerts)" ], "decisions_closed": [ "TypeScript monorepo on pnpm", "Postgres is the only database. The job queue lives inside it (pg-boss). No Redis", "Files on local disk, named by content hash, written once. S3 driver optional. No MinIO", "Backups: WAL-G for Postgres and restic for files, to an S3 bucket off the box", "State lives only in Postgres and the files folder", "One renderer: HTML + CSS in Chromium, for the editor and the server", "InDesign hand-off is IDML. No InDesign Server", "E-paper is built from the final PDF whenever one exists", "The ops desk is its own service and never depends on the API, the worker or Postgres" ], "recovery": { "state_lives_in": [ "Postgres: rows + the job queue", "the files folder: named by content hash, written once" ], "postgres": "archive_timeout 60 s; WAL-G wal-push to the off-box bucket; base backup nightly; 30 days kept; point-in-time restore into a second Postgres, compare row counts, then switch; the old one kept 7 days", "files": "restic snapshot to the off-box bucket every 15 min; soft delete for 30 days; restore one file, one edition or everything", "config": ".env, ops/services.yml and the release list ride in the same encrypted snapshot", "releases": "tagged image sets, last 5 kept; expand-only migrations, so any of them runs on today's database", "editor": "unsaved typing is kept in the browser (IndexedDB) and saved when the API returns", "targets": { "crash_restart_bad_release_power_cut": "nothing saved is lost", "dead_disk_database": "at most about 1 minute of writes", "dead_disk_files": "at most 15 minutes", "one_service_back": "1 minute", "bad_release_rolled_back": "2 minutes", "whole_box_on_new_hardware": "60 minutes" }, "honest_limits": [ "The ops desk lives on the same box. If the box is dead, run scripts/restore.sh on a new one", "Zero loss on a dead disk needs a second server with a synchronous replica", "The desk fixes services, queues, releases and data. A logic bug present in every kept release still needs a code fix" ], "tool_note": "WAL-G and restic are the default tools. The targets are the contract: swap a tool only if every M13 drill still passes." }, "modules": [ { "id": "M0", "name": "PLATFORM CORE", "lane": "STORE", "status": "BUILD NOW", "needs": "—", "purpose": "The floor every module stands on.", "tech": "TypeScript monorepo (pnpm) · Fastify + zod → OpenAPI · Postgres + Prisma · pg-boss job queue inside Postgres · files on disk or any S3 bucket · Docker Compose · Caddy", "build": [ "Repo (D7): apps/{api, worker, ops, editor, admin, reader} · packages/{core, connectors, assets, ai, layout, idml, export, epaper}", "packages/core: zod schemas for Article, PageDoc, LayoutSnapshot, Zones — the only place types are defined", "Auth: email + password (argon2), session cookie; roles owner · editor · sub · designer · viewer per paper; API key per source", "Queues on pg-boss, inside Postgres: ingest · assets · ai · layout · export · epaper — retries with backoff, job log, dead-letter list", "Files: {paper}/{yyyy-mm-dd}/{kind}/{hash}.{ext}, written once and never overwritten; drivers fs (default) and s3; signed URLs for anything private", "State lives in exactly two places: Postgres and the files folder. Every container can be deleted and rebuilt from its image", "Migrations are expand-only: add, never rename or drop in the same release, so any of the last 5 releases runs on today's database", "Audit row on every write; soft delete for 30 days; every service answers /healthz and /readyz (D9)" ], "interfaces": [ "REST /v1/* JSON; errors {code, message, details}; OpenAPI served at /docs", "Every table has paper_id; every request resolves its paper from the session or API key", "Job envelope {type, paper_id, payload, idempotency_key}", "Env: DATABASE_URL FILES_DRIVER FILES_ROOT S3_* ANTHROPIC_API_KEY APP_SECRET" ], "done_when": [ "docker compose up gives healthy api, worker, ops, postgres and proxy on one 4 vCPU / 16 GB Linux box", "Seed creates a demo paper + owner; a viewer is refused on save", "A failing job retries 3 times, then shows in the dead-letter list", "A test proves paper A cannot read paper B's rows or files", "Stop and start the whole stack: every row, file and queued job is still there" ] }, { "id": "M1", "name": "CONNECTOR HUB", "lane": "INGEST", "status": "PART-BUILT", "needs": "M0", "purpose": "Any website in. One Article out.", "tech": "fast-xml-parser · rss-parser · undici · cheerio · @mozilla/readability · jsonpath-plus", "build": [ "Connector interface: discover(cfg, since) lists refs; fetch(cfg, ref) returns a RawItem", "Kinds in v1: push · rss · wordpress · rest · cxml · scrape (ghost, drupal, newsml arrive later as adapters)", "normalize(raw, mapping) → Article; zod-validate; reject with reasons, never half-save", "Upsert key (paper_id, source_id, external_id); content_hash decides whether it changed", "Port parseCXML() from the prototype: copes with image tags nested mid-sentence, quote blocks, missing ids", "Scheduler per source (cron), push endpoint with HMAC check, file-drop watcher", "Mapping wizard + TEST endpoint: a dry run that returns 5 parsed articles and every error" ], "interfaces": [ "IN wire 1: RawItem (XML node · feed item · JSON · HTML)", "OUT wire 2: Article (D1) · wire 3: asset jobs", "POST /v1/ingest/articles · POST /v1/sources · POST /v1/sources/:id/test · POST /v1/sources/:id/sync", "Internal events article.created · article.updated" ], "done_when": [ "BlinkCMS Punjabi sample → 2 pages, 9 stories + 1 advert, 7 image refs; ContentXML export re-parses identical", "A stock WordPress site and a plain RSS feed ingest with mapping only, zero code", "HTML door gets headline, body and lead image from 3 unseen news sites on wizard defaults", "Re-sync with no changes writes nothing; an edited article bumps rev and flags the pages that use it" ] }, { "id": "M2", "name": "ASSET PIPELINE", "lane": "INGEST", "status": "PART-BUILT", "needs": "M0", "purpose": "Every picture ready for screen, print and cut-out.", "tech": "sharp (libvips) · existing Card Maker cut-out model in the browser · Poppler for PDF artwork", "build": [ "Download originals (follow redirects, size cap, type sniff); store once per content hash", "Derivatives: thumb 400 px and web 1600 px WebP; the print file is always the untouched original", "Focal point: subject box from the Card Maker model in the browser (SEG.subject), sharp attention crop on the server; a tap overrides", "Cut-out provider A, already built: Card Maker's in-browser model, SEG.cut(img) → canvas + mask → uploaded as asset kind cutout", "Cut-out provider B: a server worker with the same output, for auto-plan and batch runs", "Print check: needed px = frame width in inches × 150; warn in the editor, block nothing", "PDF or EPS artwork named by feeds (feature-1.pdf) → rasterise at 300 dpi" ], "interfaces": [ "IN wire 3: {article_id, url} or an upload", "OUT: Asset row + files; derivatives {thumb, web, cutout} · focal [x, y] · px [w, h]", "POST /v1/assets · POST /v1/assets/:id/cutout · GET /v1/assets/:id", "Wire 4: CutoutProvider.cut(image) → {png_alpha, subject_box} — one interface, two providers" ], "done_when": [ "100 mixed JPG / PNG / WebP URLs ingest; duplicates are stored once", "A cut-out shows in the editor with text wrapping its outline within 10 s", "Low-res warning matches the prototype at Broadsheet and Tabloid", "Provider down: the photo is still usable, the cut-out retries, the editor is told" ] }, { "id": "M3", "name": "AI ASSIST", "lane": "BUILD PAGES", "status": "BUILD NOW", "needs": "M0", "purpose": "Copy-fit help. Never the author.", "tech": "Claude API (model id from env) · JSON-only outputs · results cached by content hash", "build": [ "Tasks: shorten_headline(max_chars, n=3) · standfirst · caption · pull_quote · trim_to_fit(words_over) · classify_section", "trim_to_fit returns paragraph / sentence indexes to cut — never rewritten text", "pull_quote must be an exact substring of the body; checked in code", "Output language = article language (Punjabi stays Punjabi); a mismatch is rejected", "Every suggestion is stored with prompt hash, model, and who accepted or rejected it" ], "interfaces": [ "POST /v1/ai/suggest {task, article_id, constraints} → {suggestions[]}", "Wire 7 → the editor's AI panel and the M4 fit loop, as proposals only", "Queue ai; 30 s timeout; on failure there is no suggestion and the editor carries on" ], "done_when": [ "3 headline options within max_chars for the English and the Punjabi sample", "No saved page ever changes without an accept event in the audit log", "Pull-quote substring test passes on 50 articles", "API key missing → AI panel hidden, nothing else breaks" ] }, { "id": "M4", "name": "LAYOUT ENGINE + TEMPLATES", "lane": "BUILD PAGES", "status": "PART-BUILT", "needs": "M0 · M1 · M2", "purpose": "Turns a day's articles into pages that fit.", "tech": "packages/layout: HTML + CSS grid shared by editor and worker · Playwright Chromium · self-hosted woff2 fonts", "build": [ "Template = page size + 8-column grid + slots[{id, span, cols, kind, words_min, words_max, image}] + CSS + fonts", "Slot ids stay compatible with feed names: story_col_span-N-k · sidebar · feature-n · editorial · adverts-n", "Port from the prototype: row packer (stretch the last story so no hole is left), fit meter, auto-fit text size", "Auto-plan: section → page; pick a template variant by story count and lengths; fill slots by priority; honour layout_hint", "Fit loop per page: render → measure fill % → body size within [min, max] pt → image ratio → ask M3 for a cut list → flag overflow", "Snapshot: getBoundingClientRect of every frame → mm → LayoutSnapshot (D4)", "Cut-out wrap: CSS shape-outside from the alpha image; the snapshot records wrap: alpha", "Fonts per paper: licensed families uploaded as woff2; the same family names must be installed on the InDesign machine", "Phase 2: story jumps (continued on page N), baseline grid, Indic hyphenation" ], "interfaces": [ "IN wire 5: Articles + template set + ad bookings", "OUT wire 6: PageDoc (D3) · wire 8: LayoutSnapshot (D4)", "POST /v1/editions · POST /v1/editions/:id/autoplan · POST /v1/pages/:id/fit", "renderPage(pageDoc, template) → HTML: the same function in browser and worker" ], "done_when": [ "Punjabi sample plans to 2 pages; page 1 fits; page 2 reports its overflow honestly (too much copy)", "The same PageDoc in editor and headless: screenshot difference under 0.5 %", "15 English articles → 4 pages in under 60 s", "Same inputs give the same plan on every run" ] }, { "id": "M5", "name": "EDITION EDITOR", "lane": "BUILD PAGES", "status": "PART-BUILT", "needs": "M0 · M4", "purpose": "Where the sub-editor works, phone to desktop.", "tech": "React + TypeScript (Vite) around packages/layout · contenteditable · command-stack undo", "build": [ "Port the prototype tools 1:1 first: edit text, width, text columns, headline size, move across pages, photos, add story / page, page sizes", "Load + autosave PageDoc (2 s debounce) with rev; Tappable edition out.", "tech": "Poppler (pdfinfo pdfseparate pdftoppm pdftotext -bbox-layout) · sharp · Tesseract OCR fallback · Postgres full-text", "build": [ "Accept a whole-edition PDF, single-page PDFs, or a LayoutSnapshot (the no-InDesign route). audit log viewer", "E-paper desk: drop a PDF → progress → thumbnail grid → replace · hide · reorder · fix zones", "Publish schedule (say 05:00), version list, one-tap rollback", "A status light in the header: green, or a link straight to the ops desk (M13)" ], "interfaces": [ "Only the public /v1 API — no private back doors", "Zone fixer writes PATCH /v1/epaper/pages/:id/zones with source: manual", "Saving a template triggers a re-fit preview through M4" ], "done_when": [ "New paper to first auto-planned edition in under 15 min using only this console", "A wrong zone is fixed in 3 taps and survives a later page replace when the story is unchanged", "Every destructive action asks once and lands in the audit log" ] }, { "id": "M13", "name": "OPS DESK + RECOVERY", "lane": "ALL LANES", "status": "BUILD NOW", "needs": "M0", "purpose": "The owner fixes anything, at any hour, and loses nothing.", "tech": "apps/ops: one small Node service with its own port, login and state file · Docker Engine API · WAL-G (Postgres, to the minute) · restic (files) · any S3 bucket off the box", "build": [ "Stands alone: own container, own login (password + TOTP, lock after 5 wrong tries), own state in ops/state.sqlite. It must answer when the API, the worker, Postgres and the proxy are all down", "One row per service from ops/services.yml (D9): api · worker · postgres · proxy · reader · backups · disk · certificate, plus watch-only rows for the bucket, the Claude API and each source", "Each row: a light (green · amber · red), since when, the last error in plain words, Restart, Logs", "Fix buttons, every one safe to press twice: retry failed jobs · pause or resume a queue · re-sync a source · re-process an e-paper page · renew the certificate · free disk space (it lists what it will remove first)", "Releases: every deploy is a tagged image set. Roll back to any of the last 5 in one tap; expand-only migrations keep that safe", "Database: WAL shipped off the box every 60 s, a base backup every night, 30 days kept. Restore to a minute builds a second Postgres beside the live one, shows row counts side by side, then switches. The old one stays for 7 days", "Files: written once, so nothing is ever overwritten. Copied off the box every 15 min with .env and the config; deletes are soft for 30 days. Restore one file, one edition, or everything", "Every destructive button takes a snapshot first and asks for a typed confirmation. React (same shell as the editor) · role-gated routes · everything through /v1
Papers: name, language, script, page size, timezone, domain, theme
Sources: add / edit, mapping wizard, TEST, sync log, error inbox
Templates: grid + slot editor, font upload, client .idml skeleton upload
E-paper desk: drop a PDF → progress → thumbnail grid → replace · hide ·
Publish schedule (say 05:00), version list, one-tap rollback
A status light in the header: green, or a link straight to the ops desk (M13)
Only the public /v1 API — no private back doors

text.tspan: Saving a template triggers a re-fit preview through M4
New paper to first auto-planned edition in under 15 min
A wrong zone is fixed in 3 taps and survives a later page
replace when the story is unchanged
Every destructive action asks once and lands in the audit
lost on a crash, a restart, a bad
of database writes at most, if the
to bring everything back on a new
apps/ops: one small Node service with its own port, login and state file · Docker Engine API · WAL-G (Postgres, to the minute) · restic (files) · any S3 bucket off the box
Stands alone: own container, own login (password + TOTP, lock after 5
wrong tries), own state in ops/state.sqlite. It must answer when the API,
the worker, Postgres and the proxy are all down
One row per service from ops/services.yml (D9): api · worker · postgres ·
proxy · reader · backups · disk · certificate, plus watch-only rows for the
bucket, the Claude API and each source
Each row: a light (green · amber · red), since when, the last error in plain
Fix buttons, every one safe to press twice: retry failed jobs · pause or resume
a queue · re-sync a source · re-process an e-paper page · renew the
certificate · free disk space (it lists what it will remove first)
Releases: every deploy is a tagged image set. Roll back to any of the last 5
in one tap; expand-only migrations keep that safe
Database: WAL shipped off the box every 60 s, a base backup every night,
30 days kept. Restore to a minute builds a second Postgres beside the live
one, shows row counts side by side, then switches. The old one stays for 7
Files: written once, so nothing is ever overwritten. Copied off the box every
15 min with .env and the config; deletes are soft for 30 days. Restore one
Every destructive button takes a snapshot first and asks for a typed
confirmation. Every press lands in the ops log
Alerts to the owner's phone (Telegram or email) with a link to the fix: failed
check · failed backup · disk over 80 % · certificate under 14 days. Plus one
uptime monitor outside the box, because a dead box cannot report itself
A restore drill runs by itself every week into a scratch database; the desk
shows backups verified with the date
scripts/restore.sh: on a fresh Linux box it needs only the recovery kit
(bucket keys + backup password) to bring the whole system back
Front door https://ops.HOST. Back door: the desk's own port
:9443, for when the proxy is down

g.text: what the client watches, in order

text.tspan: Paste the site URL. The wizard maps it. Articles land.
Auto-plan: four English pages in about a minute.
Edit a headline live. AI offers three shorter ones.
Swap the lead photo. Cut it out. Text wraps around it.
Export IDML. It opens in InDesign with their styles.
Export PDF. The e-paper builds. Open it on a phone.
Tap a story. The site's own article opens.
Load their Punjabi ContentXML. Same engine, their language.

Their InDesign page template saved as .idml, plus the fonts

Page size, column grid, and the section → page plan
Ad slot rules and who books them
The domain for the e-paper (a CNAME)
One InDesign operator for an hour of open-tests
The chief sub-editor who signs pages off
Confirm the cut-out module to reuse: Card Maker's browser model
Demo content: the client's own site, or content we hold rights to

g.text: each risk already has a place in the design

text.tspan: The operator ignores the browser and starts fresh in InDesign
→ IDML must open clean with their styles. Track the share of frames left
Indic PDF text is unreadable (legacy fonts)
→ OCR, the snapshot prior, and the zone fixer.
Auto layout is not hand craft
→ Templates copied from their paper, approval per page, overset never hidden.
Browser justification is weaker; no Indic hyphenation yet
→ Print truth stays in InDesign. Hyphenation is phase 2.
Two copies of the text: web and print
→ article_rev on every item and a source-updated badge.
→ Fonts come from the client. Ghostscript is AGPL: unmodified CLI or a paid
licence. Scrape only owned or permitted sites.
→ Press PDF stays experimental until one trial run is signed off.
Something breaks at night and nobody technical is awake
→ M13: alert → ops desk → one tap. Drilled before hand-over, and the owner
The whole server dies, and the ops desk with it
→ Off-box backups + restore.sh on a new box in about an hour. Losing nothing
at all needs a second server.
